scope: Methodological replica with BERT-base and our Gutenberg corpus; not a reproduction of EEBO-BERT/Poetry-BERT results

source_recipe.pooling: Each verse line encoded independently; last hidden-layer mean excluding CLS and SEP
source_recipe.formula: Sum arccos(clip(dot(delta_i/(norm(delta_i)+1e-8), delta_next/(norm(delta_next)+1e-8)), -1, 1)) divided by norm(last-first); return zero for fewer than two vectors or endpoint distance below 1e-8
source_recipe.couplet_measure: Euclidean distance between final two line vectors
source_recipe.implementation: Vectorized mathematical reimplementation; no source code copied; metrics computed in float64

model.specialization: Base pretrained BERT; neither EEBO-BERT nor Poetry-BERT

execution.pooling: isolated line last hidden layer mean; exclude CLS/SEP/padding; no L2 normalization

limitations: Specialized EEBO-BERT and Poetry-BERT checkpoints were not obtained or validated for this run.
Corpus edition and batched CPU execution can differ from the source notebook.
The ratio depends on feature scale and small endpoint distances; it is not a validated measure of literary complexity.
The original epsilon convention assigns pi/2 to a turn involving a zero displacement and returns zero for near-closed trajectories; these quirks are preserved and flagged.

embedding_archive.format: lossless NumPy NPZ; float32 line embeddings plus identity arrays
